'''Thyferra's largest moon''' was the largest of two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting the planet [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. [[Erisi Dlarit]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pilot serving [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], crashed into the moon and was killed during a dogfight with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] during the [[Battle of Thyferra]].
